tokens.name: primary-normal
tokens.usage: Primary fill: the one main action per view, selected states, slider range. Used by Avatar, Badge, Button, Checkbox, DatePicker, Empty, Field, Progress, RadioGroup, Slider, Switch.

tokens.name: primary-strong
tokens.usage: Hover fill for primary-normal. Skill 1 decides lighten vs darken so on-primary keeps contrast. [Designer's choice — light, dark: a deeper hover keeps the white label readable] Used by Badge, Button.

tokens.name: primary-heavy
tokens.usage: Pressed / active fill and primary strokes on soft surfaces. Not a text ground.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Primary-coloured text and icons: links, active tab label. Must reach 4.5:1 on background-normal and -elevated in every theme. Used by Badge, Button.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for primary badges, selected rows and callouts. Pair with primary-text. Used by Badge.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary-normal, -strong and -heavy. Skill 1 picks white or ink, whichever reaches 4.5:1 on the brand fill. [Designer's choice — light, dark: white labels on Vivid Horizon (4.76:1); ink read too dark on periwinkle] Used by Avatar, Badge, Button, Checkbox, DatePicker, RadioGroup.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on secondary-normal. Skill 1 picks white or ink, whichever reaches 4.5:1. [Designer's choice — light, dark: dark lavender text on the pastel lavender fill] Used by Avatar, Badge.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-normal. Skill 1 picks white or ink, whichever reaches 4.5:1. Used by Avatar, Badge.

tokens.name: secondary-normal
tokens.usage: Secondary brand fill: toggles on, progress, info highlights. [Designer's choice — light, dark: Lavender as a light pastel fill, so secondary lifts the UI instead of weighing it down] Used by Avatar, Badge.

tokens.name: secondary-text
tokens.usage: Secondary-coloured text and icons. Must reach 4.5:1 on background-normal in every theme. Used by Badge.

tokens.name: secondary-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for secondary badges and info callouts. Pair with secondary-text. [Designer's choice — dark: a deep lavender tint keeps lavender text readable in dark mode (5.09:1)] Used by Badge.

tokens.name: accent-normal
tokens.usage: Accent highlight: 'new' markers and featured moments. One per view. Used by Avatar, Badge.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent-coloured text. Must reach 4.5:1 on background-normal in every theme. Used by Badge.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for accent badges. Pair with accent-text. Used by Badge.

tokens.name: label-normal
tokens.usage: Default text: body copy, headings, control labels. Used by Accordion, Alert, AlertDialog, Avatar, Badge, Breadcrumb, Button, Card, Combobox, DatePicker, Dialog, DropdownMenu, Empty, Input, Popover, Select, Sheet, Sidebar, Table, Tabs, Toggle.

tokens.name: label-strong
tokens.usage: Maximum-emphasis text: display headlines, numbers that must win.

tokens.name: label-neutral
tokens.usage: Slightly quieter body text: descriptions, secondary paragraphs. Used by Card, Popover.

tokens.name: label-alternative
tokens.usage: Supporting text: helper text, metadata, captions. Must reach 4.5:1 on background-normal and -alternative. Used by Accordion, Alert, AlertDialog, Avatar, Badge, Breadcrumb, Combobox, DataTable, DatePicker, Dialog, DropdownMenu, Empty, Field, InputGroup, Progress, Select, Sheet, Table, Tabs.

tokens.name: label-assistive
tokens.usage: Placeholders and tertiary hints, on background-normal / -elevated only. Used by Combobox, Input, Select, Textarea.

tokens.name: label-disable
tokens.usage: Disabled text and icons. Intentionally below 4.5:1; always paired with a disabled control. Used by Accordion, DatePicker, Tabs.

tokens.name: background-normal
tokens.usage: Page ground and the default content surface. Used by Avatar, Badge, Button, DatePicker, Field, Sidebar, Tabs.

tokens.name: background-alternative
tokens.usage: App shells, sidebars and sections that sit behind cards. Used by Sidebar.

tokens.name: background-elevated
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, dialogs, popovers, menus. Steps lighter in dark mode. Used by Accordion, Alert, AlertDialog, Card, Combobox, DatePicker, Dialog, DropdownMenu, Popover, Select, Sheet.

tokens.name: fill-normal
tokens.usage: Neutral fill: neutral badges, tracks, secondary button ground, skeletons. Used by Alert, Avatar, Badge, Button, Sidebar, Tabs.

tokens.name: fill-strong
tokens.usage: Hover for fill-normal and pressed neutral controls. Used by Button, Sidebar.

tokens.name: fill-alternative
tokens.usage: Faint fill: hovered rows, quiet button hover, code backgrounds. Used by Alert, AlertDialog, Avatar, Badge, Button, ButtonGroup, Card, Combobox, DatePicker, Dialog, DropdownMenu, Empty, Field, Progress, Select, Skeleton, Slider, Table, Tabs, Toggle.

tokens.name: thumb-normal
tokens.usage: Ground of moving control thumbs (Switch, Slider): light in every theme so it reads on any track; its edge comes from thumb-shadow. Used by Slider, Switch.

tokens.name: thumb-shadow
tokens.usage: Shadow under control thumbs, giving them an edge against light and coloured tracks.

tokens.name: line-normal
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card borders (no 3:1 requirement). Used by Avatar, Badge, Button, Card, Combobox, DropdownMenu, Popover, Select, Separator, Sidebar.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: text fields, unchecked checkboxes and radios. Must reach 3:1 on background-normal. Used by Button, ButtonGroup, Checkbox, Combobox, Input, InputGroup, RadioGroup, Select, Switch, Tabs, Textarea, Toggle.

tokens.name: status-positive
tokens.usage: Success text and icons. Always with an icon or word. Used by Alert, Badge.

tokens.name: status-positive-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for positive badges and success callouts. Used by Alert, Badge.

tokens.name: status-cautionary
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons. Always with an icon or word. Used by Alert, Badge.

tokens.name: status-cautionary-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for cautionary badges and warning callouts. Used by Alert, Badge.

tokens.name: status-negative
tokens.usage: Error text and icons, destructive outlines. If the brand primary is red, Skill 1 deepens this so error and brand never rely on hue alone. Must reach 4.5:1 on the page, in cards and on its own 10–25% tint (the destructive button and badge), in every theme; dark sits a step lighter than the other statuses for that. Used by Alert, Badge, Button, Checkbox, Combobox, DropdownMenu, Field, Input, InputGroup, RadioGroup, Select, Switch, Textarea, Toggle.

tokens.name: status-negative-soft

easing.note: Motion curves. Reduced motion removes every scale and spring.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Fades, colour and shadow changes. Used by Accordion, Card, Table.

tokens.name: ease-expressive
tokens.usage: Anything that scales or slides. Tune to the brand: flatter for calm brands, more overshoot for playful ones.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Colour changes.

tokens.name: duration-normal
tokens.usage: Presses and hovers.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Toggles and dialog entrance.

control.note: The control set's shared dimensions and text: Button, Input, InputGroup, Select, Combobox, Toggle and Textarea. Change these to change every control at once (density, a larger brand type); the heights stay a ladder (sm < md < lg).

tokens.name: control-height-sm
tokens.usage: Small controls: Button and Toggle `size="sm"`, Select `size="sm"`, and the square icon button beside them. Tailwind: `h-(--control-height-sm)`. Used by Button, Select, Toggle.

tokens.name: control-height-md
tokens.usage: The default control height: Button, Input, InputGroup, Select, Combobox's field and Toggle, so controls side by side line up. Tailwind: `h-(--control-height-md)`. Used by Button, Combobox, Input, InputGroup, Select, Toggle.

tokens.name: control-height-lg
tokens.usage: Large controls: Button and Toggle `size="lg"`. Tailwind: `h-(--control-height-lg)`. Used by Button, Toggle.

tokens.name: control-padding-x
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding inside a control: Button, Input, Select's trigger, Combobox's field, Toggle and Textarea. Tailwind: `px-(--control-padding-x)`. Used by Button, Combobox, Input, Select, Textarea, Toggle.

tokens.name: control-label-sm
tokens.usage: Text in small controls: a type style from the scale, whose size, line height and letter spacing it takes (each control keeps its own weight). Tailwind: `text-(length:--control-label-sm-size) leading-(--control-label-sm-leading) tracking-(--control-label-sm-tracking)`. Used by Button, Toggle.

tokens.name: control-label-md
tokens.usage: Text in default and large controls, and what people type in fields from the md breakpoint (below it fields stay 16px, so phones don't zoom on focus): a type style from the scale, whose size, line height and letter spacing it takes (each control keeps its own weight). Tailwind: `text-(length:--control-label-md-size) leading-(--control-label-md-leading) tracking-(--control-label-md-tracking)`. Used by Button, Combobox, Input, InputGroup, Select, Textarea, Toggle.

layer.note: Stacking order across the product: z-index values, read as z-(--layer-*). Inside one component, local order (z-10 over its own siblings) stays in code.

tokens.name: layer-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky page headers and toolbars, above the page and below every overlay. Tailwind: `z-(--layer-sticky)`.

tokens.name: layer-overlay
tokens.usage: Every overlay: dialogs, sheets, popovers, menus, selects and tooltips, with their backdrops. Tailwind: `z-(--layer-overlay)`.

breakpoint.note: Screen widths where layouts change. They are Tailwind's own sm/md/lg/xl/2xl, so `md:` follows these values; use-mobile reads breakpoint-md. Keep them in rem and in order.

tokens.name: breakpoint-sm
tokens.usage: Large phones in landscape. Tailwind: `sm:`.

tokens.name: breakpoint-md
tokens.usage: Tablets: below it is mobile (use-mobile, the Sidebar's sheet, fields' 16px text, display and title sizes' mobile steps). Tailwind: `md:`.

tokens.name: breakpoint-lg
tokens.usage: Laptops. Tailwind: `lg:`.

tokens.name: breakpoint-xl
tokens.usage: Desktops. Tailwind: `xl:`.

tokens.name: breakpoint-2xl
tokens.usage: Wide screens. Tailwind: `2xl:`.

icon.note: Icon sizes. Components size their icons with these; an icon's stroke colour comes from its text token.

tokens.name: icon-xs
tokens.usage: Icons in the smallest controls (Button xs, a chip's remove). Tailwind: `size-(--icon-xs)`. Used by Avatar, Badge, Button.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons in small controls (Button and Toggle sm). Tailwind: `size-(--icon-sm)`. Used by Breadcrumb, Button, Checkbox, DatePicker, InputGroup, Toggle.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: The default icon: in controls, menus, alerts and fields. Tailwind: `size-(--icon-md)`. Used by Alert, Avatar, Breadcrumb, Button, ButtonGroup, Combobox, DropdownMenu, Empty, Field, InputGroup, Pagination, Select, Sidebar, Sonner, Tabs, Toggle.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Icons that lead a block: an empty state's media, a large button. Tailwind: `size-(--icon-lg)`. Used by Avatar.

tokens.name: icon-xl
tokens.usage: Standalone icons. Tailwind: `size-(--icon-xl)`.

border.note: Line widths: every border's default width, and the focus outline every focusable control shows.

tokens.name: border-width
tokens.usage: The width of every `border` (Tailwind's default border width follows it): control borders, dividers, card outlines.

tokens.name: focus-ring-width
tokens.usage: The focus outline's width on every focusable control (the global :focus-visible rule). WCAG 2.2 asks for at least 2px.

tokens.name: focus-ring-offset
tokens.usage: The gap between a control and its focus outline.

contrastMore.note: What changes when someone asks their OS for more contrast (prefers-contrast: more): each token on the left takes the value on the right, in every theme the app renders. Lines strengthen, secondary text darkens, the focus outline thickens. Design owns these like any token.
